hypothesis_source: Leader-VCP path review: 49% of non-winners never printed +3% in the first two bars. Sequence 5 is already the live plan (MA20 reclaim). Sequence 4 skip-gap-up failed. This round: on the same reclaim T+1 fills, if max(high of entry session, high of next session) / entry_open - 1 < 0.03, exit at the open two sessions after entry. Otherwise keep the scheduled 10/20-day open exit.
distinct_from_failed_representations: Not a 5% stop. Not pivot-break. Not waiting after breakout. Same reclaim entries as v1. One event: no +3% demand in two bars.
entry: Unchanged: watch-list MA20 reclaim, T+1 open, buy all fills.

exit.definition: Entry session is t+1. If max(high[t+1], high[t+2]) < entry_open * 1.03, sell at open[t+3]. Missing high or blocked early sell makes that path incomplete (no roll). Else scheduled 10/20 open.

control: Same fills, scheduled 10/20-day open exit (v1 windows).

pass_fail.pass: 10-day and 20-day date-EW net with the two-bar rule is not worse than scheduled 10/20 on the same fills.
pass_fail.fail: Stop this invalidation. Keep scheduled 10/20 exit. Do not scan 3%.
